note.note:
I’m missing the actual transcript and the differential diagnosis (DDx) data to generate the SOAP note.

Please provide:
- The full patient-doctor transcript (text of the visit).
- The DDx in JSON format as described (the differential diagnoses aligned with the case).

Once received, I will produce:
- Subjective: current issues, HPI, PMH, medications, social history, allergies.
- Objective: relevant exam findings and any investigations/results.
- Assessment & Plan:
  - For each issue: name, likely diagnosis, consistent differentials from the DDx (with conflict noted if applicable), planned investigations, treatments, and referrals.
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, internal conflicts between transcript and DDx, and a brief comment on transcript quality.

If you can’t share the JSON, you can paste the list of differential diagnoses and I’ll incorporate them accordingly.
